title: When Single-Dataset Conclusions Fail: A 45-Task Study of Threshold Tuning and Resampling for Imbalanced Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.16147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Class-imbalance handling is routinely evaluated on a single benchmark dataset, and the resulting conclusions are reported as if they were properties of the method. We show this practice is unsafe. On the public Kaggle credit-card fraud dataset, under a leakage-free nested cross-validation protocol in which the decision threshold is selected on a held-out inner validation fold, a plain Random Forest at the default 0.5 threshold attains F1 = 0.861 +/- 0.021, and threshold tuning yields it no benefit (delta-F1 = -0.002). Read alone, this supports an appealing conclusion: for a well-calibrated ensemble, imbalance handling is unnecessary.   We then apply the identical protocol to 45 binary tasks spanning imbalance ratios from 1:1.5 to 1:178 (2,025 model fits, four model families). The conclusion reverses. translated_title: 当单一数据集结论失效：一项关于不平衡分类中阈值调整与重采样的45任务研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16147v1 公告类型：新 摘要：类不平衡处理通常在单一基准数据集上进行评估，所得结论被当作方法本身的属性来报告。我们证明这种做法是不安全的。在公开的Kaggle信用卡欺诈数据集上，采用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证协议（决策阈值在保留的内部验证折上选择），默认阈值为0.5的普通随机森林达到了F1 = 0.861 ± 0.021，而阈值调整未带来任何收益（Δ-F1 = -0.002）。单独来看，这支持了一个有吸引力的结论：对于校准良好的集成模型，不平衡处理是不必要的。随后，我们将相同的协议应用于45个二元任务，涵盖不平衡比率从1:1.5到1:178（共2,025次模型拟合，四种模型家族）。结论发生了逆转。随机森林在整个任务套件中从阈值调整中获益最多（Δ-F1 = +0.101 ± 0.134），而其他三种家族则相反。
tldr: 本研究通过45个任务的大规模实验证明，基于单一数据集得出的不平衡处理结论可能不可靠，随机森林在跨任务套件中从阈值调整中获益显著。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through a large-scale 45-task experiment that conclusions about imbalance handling based on a single dataset can be unreliable, with Random Forest benefiting significantly from threshold tuning across the task suite.
